images.alt: Netflix Games screen on mobile phone
Spotify audiobooks displayed on smartphone screens
You can now talk to Spotify

items.content: Over the past decade, streaming platforms competed by dominating individual formats like music, video, podcasts, or audiobooks. Now, as AI makes it easier to create, organize, and recommend content, those distinctions are fading, pushing companies like Spotify, Netflix, YouTube, and TikTok to become all-purpose entertainment destinations instead.
